issue_context.title: [BUG] Cannot match a selector with an empty string
issue_context.body:
**Context:** - OS: macOS 11.6 - Memory: 10.60 GB / 64.00 GB - Node: 16.11.1 - /usr/local/bin/node - npm: 8.0.0 - /usr/local/bin/npm - Bash: 5.1.8 - /usr/local/bin/bash - playwright: 1.15.2 => 1.15.2 ## Problem description Trying to match empty text does not seem to work **selectors I tried**: - `#fluidWidthSpan >> text=//` # matches any string - `#fluidWidthSpan:text("")` # matches any string - `#fluidWidthSpan >> text=''` # doesn't match - `#fluidWidthSpan >> text=""` # doesn't match - `#fluidWidthSpan:text-is("")` # doesnt match - `#fluidWidthSpan :text-is("")`# doesnt match - `#fluidWidthSpan:text-matches("")`# matches anything - `#fluidWidthSpan:empty` # does not stop matching when a single character is added, though if I add two characters it stops matching, and if i remove one of those characters it continues to not match. This might be worth a separate bug. Here's the HTML: ```html
  • GETmethod
  • POSTmethod
  • PUTmethod
  • DELETEmethod
  • PATCHmethod
  • OPTIONSmethod
``` Here's the playwright code (tried with all the selectors listed above): ``` await page.waitForSelector("#fluidWidthSpan:text-is('')"); ```
comments: Thanks for the amazingly fast fix, @yury-s!
